objective.en: Notice how everyday habits can leave food unused.
objective.zh: 发现日常习惯如何让食物未被使用。

basis.en: Estimated lesson and activity time; no timer.
basis.zh: 课程与活动预计时间；没有倒计时。

text.en: Watch the one-minute story, or read this summary. Food can slip out of sight while shopping and meal plans move on. Checking what is already at home creates a useful pause before buying more.
text.zh: 观看一分钟故事，或阅读这份摘要。购物和餐食安排不断变化，食物却可能被遗忘。多买之前先查看家里已有的食物，是一个有用的停顿。

text.en: OzHarvest's 2025 research describes Australian households with someone under 35 discarding about 113 kg of food a year, valued at over A$1,500. This is a survey estimate for that group, not a measurement of you.
text.zh: OzHarvest 2025 年研究估计，有 35 岁以下成员的澳大利亚家庭每年丢弃约 113 kg 食物，价值超过 A$1,500。这是该群体的调查估计，不是对你的测量。

text.en: Name one ingredient you already have that could be part of your next meal.
text.zh: 找出一种家里已有、可以用于下一餐的食材。

objective.en: Identify a material before choosing its collection route.
objective.zh: 先辨认材料，再选择收集方式。

basis.en: Estimated lesson and activity time; no timer.
basis.zh: 课程与活动预计时间；没有倒计时。

text.en: Start with what the item actually is. Food scraps, metal, paper, glass and plastics have different roles. A package can contain several of them. A silver-looking object or an illustration alone does not prove a material.
text.zh: 先确认物品本身是什么。食物残余、金属、纸、玻璃和塑料是不同类别；一件包装可能包含多种材料。银色外观或插图本身不能证明材质。

items.zh: 普通纸板 → 纸类材料。

items.en: Scrunchable plastic film → soft plastic, not a rigid container.
items.zh: 可揉团的塑料薄膜 → 软塑料，不是硬容器。

text.en: Now check the route. Read instructions for each packaging part and the local service. A recycling triangle or plastic code does not by itself confirm that your council accepts the item. When uncertain, look it up instead of adding it to recycling.
text.zh: 再核对处理方式。查看各包装部件说明与当地服务。回收三角符号或塑料编号本身并不保证当地 council 接受该物品。不确定时先查，不直接塞进回收。

text.en: Example: a snack has a cardboard sleeve and a soft-plastic wrapper. Identify both parts; do not let the sleeve's recycling instruction stand in for the wrapper's.
text.zh: 例子：零食有纸板套和软塑料膜。应分别辨认，不能把纸板套的回收说明套用到薄膜上。

text.en: Choose one package at home. Find its parts, material clues and collection instructions. If something is missing, note what you need to check.
text.zh: 选一件家里的包装，找出部件、材质线索和收集说明。若信息不足，记下需要核对的内容。

objective.en: Apply three clearly stated collection examples.
objective.zh: 练习三个服务条件明确的分类示例。

basis.en: Estimated lesson and activity time; no timer.
basis.zh: 课程与活动预计时间；没有倒计时。

text.en: Practise with an empty aluminium can, a banana peel and a clean cardboard box. Each question states what the example service accepts. Choose by tapping a bin, or use the drag interaction when available.
text.zh: 练习空铝罐、香蕉皮和干净纸箱。每题会说明示例服务接受什么。可以点选桶，或在可用时拖拽物品。

text.en: Read the explanation after each first answer. A demonstration retry helps you learn, but does not replace the recorded first answer. Finish all three feedback steps to complete this activity.
text.zh: 首次作答后阅读解释。再次演示有助于学习，但不会改写首次答案。确认三题反馈后完成此活动。

text.en: This practice uses teaching items. It does not consume fridge stock or count as a real disposal. Your Beginner checkpoint remains a separate six-question assessment.
text.zh: 练习使用教学物品，不消耗冰箱库存，也不算真实投放。初级 checkpoint 是另外的六题测验。

text.en: What detail in the collection instructions changed your decision?
text.zh: 收集说明中的哪个细节影响了你的选择？

objective.en: Read and separate packaging components appropriately.
objective.zh: 正确阅读并分清包装部件。

basis.en: Estimated lesson and activity time; no timer.
basis.zh: 课程与活动预计时间；没有倒计时。

text.en: One product does not always mean one disposal instruction. A box, inner wrap and lid may have different instructions. Find the name of each part, then read the instruction attached to that part.
text.zh: 一个产品不一定只有一种处理说明。盒、内膜和盖子可能各有要求。先找到部件名称，再阅读属于该部件的说明。

text.en: The Australasian Recycling Label distinguishes recyclable, conditionally recyclable and not recyclable components. A condition may require preparation or a collection route. Do not skip it or apply one part's symbol to everything.
text.zh: Australasian Recycling Label 区分可回收、有条件可回收和不可回收部件。条件可能要求准备步骤或特定收集方式，不能跳过，也不能把一个部件的标识当作全部包装的说明。

text.en: Example: after safely using the food in a tub, separate any residue from the packaging. Check the tub and lid instructions. For glass jar lids, the council's rules can differ; do not assume every lid stays on or off.
text.zh: 例子：安全使用盒中食物后，将残余与包装分开，查看盒身与盖子的说明。玻璃罐盖的 council 规则可能不同，不要认为所有盖子都应保留或取下。

text.en: Read a multi-part package. Can you name the instruction for every part? Only separate parts in the way the instructions require.
text.zh: 阅读一个多部件包装。你能说出每个部件的要求吗？只按说明要求分离。

objective.en: Prepare accepted items without contaminating a collection.
objective.zh: 按要求准备可接受物品，避免污染收集流。

basis.en: Estimated lesson and activity time; no timer.
basis.zh: 课程与活动预计时间；没有倒计时。

text.en: A collection stream works best when it contains the items the service expects. Extra food, plastic bags or the wrong material can make recovery harder. Preparation follows the receiving service, not a universal ritual.
text.zh: 收集流中最好只包含该服务预期接收的物品。多余食物、塑料袋或错误材料可能妨碍回收。准备方式以接收服务为准，并非处处一样。

items.en: Empty accepted containers; rinse if needed.
items.zh: 倒空可接受的容器，必要时冲洗。

items.en: Keep mixed-recycling items loose where the service requires it.
items.zh: 服务要求散放时，不将混合回收物装袋。

items.en: Keep paper/cardboard clean and dry; tissues are different.
items.zh: 纸与纸板保持干净、干燥；纸巾需区别处理。

items.en: Remove packaging and fruit stickers from FOGO scraps.
items.zh: 从 FOGO 食物残余中去掉包装和水果贴纸。

text.en: Example: a used yogurt tub and a banana peel are not one waste item. The remaining food needs its accepted organics route; the empty tub needs its own material and collection check.
text.zh: 例子：用过的酸奶盒与香蕉皮不是同一种废弃物。剩余食物应核对合适的有机物收集方式；空盒需另外核对材质和收集要求。

text.en: Find one preparation step you can make easier with a small kitchen routine.
text.zh: 找出一个可以通过厨房小习惯更容易完成的准备步骤。

objective.en: Verify a current collection service for a specific item.
objective.zh: 为具体物品核实有效的收集服务。

basis.en: Estimated lesson and activity time; no timer.
basis.zh: 课程与活动预计时间；没有倒计时。

text.en: Victoria's guide is a starting point, not proof that your home has every service. Check the council or private waste provider for the address. Service availability, glass separation and lid instructions can differ.
text.zh: Victoria 指引是起点，不能证明你的住所拥有所有服务。应按地址查看 council 或私人垃圾服务商。服务是否提供、玻璃是否分收以及盖子要求都可能不同。

text.en: Soft-plastic collections can change. Confirm a service is active and accepts the exact item before using it. A photograph, an old post or a recycling triangle is not enough.
text.zh: 软塑料收集安排会变化。使用之前确认服务正在运行，并接受该具体物品。照片、旧帖或回收三角符号都不足以保证。

text.en: CDS Vic is a separate option for eligible drink containers. Use its official eligibility check and current refund-point finder. Ordinary jars and other containers do not become eligible simply because they are glass or metal.
text.zh: CDS Vic 是符合条件饮料容器的另一种选择。应使用官方资格查询与有效退费点地图。普通罐子或其他容器不会仅因为是玻璃或金属就自动符合条件。

text.en: Find the provider serving your home. Write down one item rule you had to look up rather than guess.
text.zh: 找到服务你住所的提供方，记下一项你需要查而非猜的物品规则。

objective.en: Build one meal and shopping list around existing food.
objective.zh: 围绕已有食物安排一餐和购物清单。

basis.en: Estimated lesson and activity time; no timer.
basis.zh: 课程与活动预计时间；没有倒计时。

text.en: Start before the shop. Look through the fridge, freezer and pantry, then choose ingredients that need using soon while still safe. A simple use-first area keeps them visible.
text.zh: 从购物前开始。查看冰箱、冷冻室和储物柜，优先考虑仍安全且需要尽快使用的食物。简单的优先使用区可以让它们更可见。

text.en: Plan for the people who will actually eat. Link meals that share ingredients, and add only missing items to the list. A bulk bargain is not useful if it exceeds what you can use.
text.zh: 按实际就餐人数计划。安排能共用食材的餐食，只把缺少的物品加到清单。如果买得超过能使用的量，大包装优惠也未必有用。

text.en: Example: you have carrots and half a tub of an ingredient. Plan a meal around them before choosing a recipe that requires a new shop. When plans change, review perishables again and make a safe storage plan.
text.zh: 例子：已有胡萝卜和半盒食材时，先围绕它们计划一餐，再考虑需要重新购物的菜谱。安排改变后，再查看易腐食物并制定安全储存计划。

text.en: Plan one meal using what you already have. List only what is missing, and check portions.
text.zh: 用已有食物计划一餐，只列出缺少的物品，并核对份量。

objective.en: Use date labels and storage instructions safely.
objective.zh: 安全理解日期标签与储存说明。

basis.en: Estimated lesson and activity time; no timer.
basis.zh: 课程与活动预计时间；没有倒计时。

text.en: Use-by is a safety limit: do not eat food after that date. Best-before mainly concerns quality. It is not a promise that any food is safe regardless of storage or condition.
text.zh: Use-by 是安全期限：过期后不要食用。Best-before 主要涉及品质，并不保证任何储存方式、任何状态下的食物都安全。

text.en: Follow the product's storage and preparation instructions. Keep perishable food refrigerated at 5°C or colder. Thaw frozen perishable food in the fridge or with a microwave rather than at room temperature.
text.zh: 遵循产品的储存和准备说明。易腐食物应冷藏在 5°C 或更低温度；冷冻易腐食物应在冰箱或用微波炉解冻，不采用室温解冻。

text.en: Label and date freezer portions so they are identifiable. Visibility helps you remember food, but must not replace safe cold storage. Do not invent a longer use-by date or rely only on a normal smell.
text.zh: 标注冷冻份量的名称和日期，方便辨认。让食物可见有助于记得使用，但不能替代安全冷藏。不要自行延长 use-by 日期，也不要只凭气味正常作判断。

text.en: Read one food label. Identify the date type and storage instructions, and decide a safe plan before the relevant limit.
text.zh: 阅读一个食品标签，辨认日期类型和储存要求，在相应期限前安排安全使用。

objective.en: Connect waste prevention to evidence and SDG 13.3.
objective.zh: 将减废与证据及 SDG 13.3 联系起来。

basis.en: Estimated lesson and activity time; no timer.
basis.zh: 课程与活动预计时间；没有倒计时。

text.en: Food uses land, water and energy before it is eaten. Preventing edible waste helps avoid wasting those inputs. Suitable organics collection handles unavoidable scraps; it cannot undo the resources already used.
text.zh: 食物在食用前就需要土地、水和能源。避免可食用食物浪费也关注这些投入。合适的有机物收集可以处理无法避免的残余，却不能撤销已经投入的资源。

text.en: Read climate data with its scope. UNFCCC's 2024 article links food loss and waste to 8–10% of annual global greenhouse gas emissions. This includes both loss and waste, globally; it is not a percentage saved by this learner.
text.zh: 阅读气候数据时保留范围。UNFCCC 2024 年文章将食物损失和浪费与全球年度温室气体排放的 8–10% 联系起来。它同时涵盖损失与浪费、范围为全球，并非本学习者节省的比例。

text.en: SDG 13.3 includes climate education and awareness. These lessons and reflection support that educational direction. Quiz results measure learning performance, not national curriculum indicators or personal carbon savings.
text.zh: SDG 13.3 包含气候教育与意识提升。课程和反思符合这一教育方向。测验成绩反映学习表现，不测量国家课程指标或个人减排量。

text.en: Choose one prevention habit for this week. Describe the action you will take without claiming a measured emissions saving.
text.zh: 为本周选一个预防浪费的习惯，说明要做的行动，不把它写成已经测量的减排量。
